vson_p:
# Annotation example: a strike Event with extractor confidence on its
# thematic-role edges. Demonstrates: vso:Annotation reification (RDF 1.1
# portable form per spec §18) carrying vso:confidence on each annotated
# triple. The canonical RDF-star form `<< :strike vso:patient :boar >>
# vso:confidence "0.95"` is equivalent and supported when authoring in
# Turtle 1.2 directly.

(scene / Composition
   :framedBy (cam / CameraView :angle low :focalLength 35mm :framing medium_shot)
   :viewedBy cam

   :depicts (knight / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Named :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Human
               :hasQuality (q1 / Quality :dimension Role :value knight))

   :depicts (boar / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Agentive :countability Count
               :class Animal
               :hasQuality (q2 / Quality :dimension Affect :value angry))

   :depicts (sword / PhysicalObject
               :individuation Generic :animacy Inert :countability Count
               :class Weapon)

   :depicts (strike / Event :lemma strike
               :agent knight :patient boar :instrument sword)

   :hasFact (a1 / Annotation
               :annotatedSubject strike :annotatedPredicate agent
               :annotatedObject knight :confidence 0.95)
   :hasFact (a2 / Annotation
               :annotatedSubject strike :annotatedPredicate patient
               :annotatedObject boar :confidence 0.70)
   :hasFact (a3 / Annotation
               :annotatedSubject strike :annotatedPredicate instrument
               :annotatedObject sword :confidence 0.88))
